"""
Module: lru_cache_with_ttl
==========================

This module implements a highly configurable, thread-safe Least Recently Used (LRU)
cache with Time-To-Live (TTL) expiration capabilities. It is designed for high-concurrency
environments and includes comprehensive error handling, logging, and metrics.

Features:
---------
1. LRU Eviction Policy: Automatically removes the least recently used items when the
   cache capacity is exceeded.
2. TTL Expiration: Items can be assigned a Time-To-Live (TTL). Expired items are
   lazily evicted upon access or eagerly during maintenance cycles.
3. Thread Safety: All read and write operations are protected by fine-grained locking
   mechanisms to ensure data consistency in multi-threaded environments.
4. Lazy and Eager Expiration: Expired entries are removed when accessed (lazy) and
   during periodic background cleanup (eager).
5. Callback Support: Supports pre-get, post-get, pre-set, post-set, and on-evict callbacks.
6. Metrics and Monitoring: Tracks hits, misses, evictions, and memory usage.
7. Persistence: Optional support for saving and loading cache state to/from JSON.
8. Extensibility: Designed with inheritance in mind for custom cache implementations.
